prerequisites: Fundamentals of strength materials. Analysis of beam, plate and shell structures. Fundamentals of engineering materials.
Skills in basic CAD tolls. Skills for solving basic engineering elements with use of classical elastic theory.

learning_outcomes.text: Have knowledge in the fundamentals of finite element method
Have the knowledge to prepare proper geometrical and discrete model to solve FEM task.
Is able to use FEM in practical application of calculation of engineering structures. Can formulate and solve problems of the ultimate strength of load carrying structures.
Skills in software for the FEA
Have the knowledge to prepare proper geometrical and discrete model to solve the task in the range of elastic deformation.
Is able to perform FEA in the field of liner and nonlinear statics, dynamics, vibrations and linear buckling.
Learn the responsibility for his work.
Learn team work due to the necessity of information flow during project realisation

syllabus_topics: Development of the numerical methods in the theory of constitutive equations.
Introduction and basic assumptions of FEM
Approximation functions, classifications of finite elements, convergence conditions
Construction of stiffness matrix of the fundamental finite elements (plate, shield, beam, solid)
Characteristics of the fundamental finite elements 1D, 2D, 3D and presentation of the basic relations
Definition of the material model used in simulations of static, dynamic problems with use of FEM.
Numerical simulations with use of FEM in statics, dynamics and thermal problems
Discrete model creation principles. Assumptions and simplifications of the model
Solid models discretization. Analysis of the parameters (type of the element, mesh density) and its influence on the results.
Designing and modeling of the thin walled beam and shell structures
Boundary conditions: DOF and load application
Principles of the creation of the complex models of load carrying structures.
Principles of design and modeling of structural nodes and the load transfer
Modal analysis, buckling and thermal load
Individual modeling of selected structural node
teaching_methods: self study - preparation for project class
individual work and preparation to the exam

assessment_methods.method: mark on the basis of the simulation project part

assessment_rules: The final grade for lectures (P) is based on the exam (F1). The final grade for the project (P) is based on the simulation project part (F1).
